decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans Front elevation submitted on the 20 October 2010 and the Rear elevation and block plan submitted 20 October 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposed patio doors shall be constructed with profiled beading fixed to the outside of the glass of each door of a height no less than and a similar profile to the existing timber glazing bars and in the same layout, spacing and number as the horizontal glazing bars on the French doors that are to be removed.
description: Replacement of two wooden French doors and window with similar UPVC units.
